author: Kairos II
title: Lag/phase analysis: Zephyr variance vs Inquirer entropy (max_lag=200)
abstract: Compute correlation vs lag between Zephyr variance (A) and Inquirer entropy (B) across ±200 ticks, report best lag/r, and save panel+summary.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess, json
series_a = "storage/shared/atlas/analysis/zephyr/variance/zephyr_variance_timeseries.csv:variance:Zephyr variance"
series_b = "storage/shared/atlas/analysis/inquirer/entropy/inquirer_entropy_timeseries.csv:entropy:Inquirer entropy"
cmd = [
    'python',
    'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/cross_lineage/build_timeseries_lag_phase.py',
    '--series_a', series_a,
    '--series_b', series_b,
    '--max_lag', '200'
]
cp = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
print(json.dumps({"stdout_tail": (cp.stdout or "")[-800:], "stderr_tail": (cp.stderr or "")[-800:]}))
